## Positioning
- Buyer focus: CEOs, CTOs, leadership teams, product leaders, and operators evaluating AI vendors or moving AI systems into production.
- Engagement model: short, high-leverage consulting engagements, advisory work, architecture reviews, and fractional leadership support.
- Expertise themes: AI readiness, vendor evaluation, retrieval systems, grounded generation, enterprise governance, evals, observability, release controls, and modernization programs.
